findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: everyinfra_list_capabilities, everyinfra_call_api, everyinfra_chat, everyinfra_search, everyinfra_tickets, everyinfra_create_ticket, everyinfra_get_ticket, everyinfra_ticket_create, everyinfra_ticket_reply · Private data: everyinfra_get_job, everyinfra_chat, everyinfra_list_captcha_types, everyinfra_account, everyinfra_usage, everyinfra_requests, everyinfra_billing, everyinfra_keys, everyinfra_create_ticket, everyinfra_key_create, everyinfra_key_update, everyinfra_key_delete, everyinfra_webhook_set · Public sink: everyinfra_list_captcha_types, everyinfra_create_ticket, everyinfra_settings_update, everyinfra_webhook_set, everyinfra_webhook_test, everyinfra_ticket_reply · Destructive: everyinfra_chat, everyinfra_search, everyinfra_key_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: everyinfra_list_capabilities, everyinfra_call_api, everyinfra_chat, everyinfra_search, everyinfra_tickets, everyinfra_create_ticket, everyinfra_get_ticket, everyinfra_ticket_create, everyinfra_ticket_reply · Private data: everyinfra_get_job, everyinfra_chat, everyinfra_list_captcha_types, everyinfra_account, everyinfra_usage, everyinfra_requests, everyinfra_billing, everyinfra_keys, everyinfra_create_ticket, everyinfra_key_create, everyinfra_key_update, everyinfra_key_delete, everyinfra_webhook_set · Public sink: everyinfra_list_captcha_types, everyinfra_create_ticket, everyinfra_settings_update, everyinfra_webhook_set, everyinfra_webhook_test, everyinfra_ticket_reply · Destructive: everyinfra_chat, everyinfra_search, everyinfra_key_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
